# XSTest — vendored data provenance

- Source: https://github.com/paul-rottger/xstest (file `xstest_prompts.csv`, main branch)
- Paper: Röttger et al., "XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety
  Behaviours in Large Language Models", arXiv:2308.01263 (NAACL 2024).
- License: CC BY 4.0 (see upstream repo). Vendored unmodified for reproducibility.
- Contents: 450 prompts — 250 safe (should be answered) + 200 unsafe (should be refused).
- Fetched: 2026-07-04 for OPUS_TASKS T12.
